subject: Request: Pilot lifespan buffer for Fintronics (SSO & webhook work)
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@fintronics.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@fintronics.io>
Date: 2026-09-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot stalled — can we ask for a cushion/extension?

Hi Hannah,

Quick update from our side: we hit two blockers during the sandbox demo yesterday. Our IdP is returning an unexpected SAML attribute (department vs dept) which is breaking our SSO flow, and the webhook consumer your adapter ships is rejecting events where the customer_id is nested under payload.meta (our webhook contract was updated last quarter).

Engineering is tied up with a vendor upgrade this week and we won't be able to finish the fixes within the pilot window you gave us. Procurement also needs a bit more runway to finalize the PO. Would Redwood consider a short extension plus additional sandbox credits so we can run an end-to-end pass once the SSO + webhook fixes land? I attached the SSO error log and the webhook payload we used.

Appreciate any help — want to avoid a dropped pilot.

—Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Integrations, Fintronics
alex.wu@fintronics.io
attachments: sso-error-log.txt, webhook-schema-v2.json

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@fintronics.io>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@fintronics.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot stalled — can we ask for a cushion/extension?

Alex — thanks for the clear note and the logs, that helps. I’m looping in Ben (AE) and Connor (eng) to size the technical effort and propose a pilot cushion. We want to keep the momentum and will escalate a promo approval internally to make sure procurement has visibility.

Ben/Connor — can you review the two attachments and advise: 1) a reasonable amount of sandbox credits (token or compute) to cover a final end-to-end test, and 2) a suggested extension window so Fintronics can get a PO and validate SSO/webhook changes? I’ll flag this as time-sensitive in HubSpot and follow up with leadership for an expedited sign-off.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-17T12:23:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot stalled — can we ask for a cushion/extension?

Quick technical triage after reviewing sso-error-log.txt and webhook-schema-v2.json:
- SSO: Fintronics IdP is mapping the department attribute to "department" while our SAML matcher expects "dept". Fix is straightforward (attribute aliasing in our SAML middleware) but needs a patch + validation across environments. Estimate: 3 business days to patch + 1 day to validate with their IdP.
- Webhooks: Their payload uses nested customer_id under payload.meta for a small subset of events; our current consumer flattens customer_id at root. We'll add a tolerant parsing pass and a feature-flagged deploy to staging. Estimate: 5 business days to implement + 2 days for joint validation.

Combined, realistic ETA for end-to-end green is 8–10 business days, assuming no further edge cases. To avoid the pilot expiring mid-fix, I recommend "pilot cushion": 45,000 token-equivalent sandbox credits and a 21-day extension to the pilot end date. That should cover repeated validation runs and the procurement delay.

I’ll prepare a short validation checklist for the upcoming session. If leadership prefers a smaller credit amount we can scope the validation test down, but 45k gives us comfortable coverage.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@fintronics.io>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot stalled — can we ask for a cushion/extension?

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and for sharing the logs. We want to keep Fintronics in a good position to complete the pilot. Per Connor’s assessment, we can offer a pilot cushion as follows: 45,000 token-equivalent sandbox credits + a 21-day extension to your pilot window.

Two quick asks so we can process this: 
1) Please confirm a revised demo window (two proposed slots next week attached in the mutual action plan).
2) If procurement needs to raise a PO, can you share an expected PO date so we can align the extension window accordingly?

I’ve created a HubSpot task and linked the mutual action plan here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/4567890. Once you confirm the demo slot and PO timing I’ll route for final approval and we’ll issue the credit grant.

If acceptable, I’ll also schedule a 60-minute joint validation session with Connor and your engineering lead.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
attachments: mutual_action_plan_fintronics_v2.pdf

Hi Ben/Hannah,

Thanks — that sounds promising and appreciated. Procurement expects to issue the PO by 2026-09-27, so the 21-day window should cover validation if we aim for the joint session the week of 9/28. Can you confirm you’ll hold credits until PO clears and share the confirmation when the grant is processed?

We’d prefer a session on 2026-09-29 or 2026-09-30 (afternoon PT).

Regards,
Priya Desai
Senior Program Manager, Fintronics
priya.desai@fintronics.io

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Pilot stalled — can we ask for a cushion/extension? — APPROVED (one-off)

Hannah/Team — I reviewed Connor’s estimates and Ben’s proposed terms. I authorize a one-off pilot cushion: 45,000 token-equivalent sandbox credits + a 21-day extension to Fintronics’ pilot end date. Conditions: log the reason code in HubSpot ("integration_delay_promo"), attach the mutual action plan to the deal record, and require a joint validation session (Connor or a delegated engineer must be present).

Ben — please process the credit grant once Priya confirms the PO timing and update the HubSpot record with the grant ID. Hannah — mark this as escalated for revenue operations so we capture the promotion in the quarterly report.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Operations
